lesson.title: Emergency Hyperkalemia Algorithm
lesson.summary: Fast visual algorithm for stabilizing, shifting, and removing potassium.

mcq.question_stem: What is the best immediate treatment?
mcq.clinical_case: ESRD patient missed dialysis. K 6.9. ECG peaked T waves.
mcq.explanation: ECG changes require immediate membrane stabilization with IV calcium.
mcq.clinical_pearl: In severe hyperkalemia with ECG changes, calcium comes first.
